title: Searah Muara Bakau - Loading Master
raw_description:
Searah is a leading independent integrated energy company in Southeast Asia, established in 2026 through the strategic partnership between Eni and PETRONAS. With a current asset base of 19 assets across Malaysia and Indonesia, Searah stands as one of the leading players in the Asia Pacific energy sector. In Indonesia, Searah Muara Bakau serves as one of Searah’s operating companies. Its operations span the exploration, development, and production of offshore natural gas resources, with a strong focus on the deepwater areas of the Kutei Basin in the Makassar Strait, contributing to energy security across Southeast Asia and the sustainable development of the communities where it operates.


Purpose:

The Loading Master is a senior marine officer responsible for the safe and efficient management of all hydrocarbon cargo and ballast water systems onboard the FPSO. This includes ensuring vessel stability and trim, maintaining cargo quality specifications, and preparing for offloading operations. The role requires deep coordination with the Topside Operations team to balance production with storage capacity and acts as the lead for the cargo and ballast control operators. Strict adherence to Indonesian national regulations is mandatory.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

A. Cargo & Ballast Management:

  • Cargo Planning: Develop and execute detailed cargo and ballast management plans to maintain the FPSO's stability, hull stress, upright heel/list and draught within designed limits at all times. Develop plan and execute work sequence during cargo offload to offtake tanker.
  • System Operation: Manage and oversee the operation of the cargo and ballast systems, including pumps, valves, inert system, crude oil washing system and stripping systems, via the ship's automated control system.
  • Storage Management: Monitor tank levels, temperatures, and pressures for all cargo tanks, slop tanks, and all other tanks including ballast tanks. Coordinate with Production to manage incoming production flow against available storage capacity.

Stability & Stress Calculations: Perform daily and critical-operation stability, trim, and shear force/bending moment calculations using dedicated software. Issue formal reports.

B. Cargo Quality Assurance:

  • Quality Control: Work closely with the Production Chemist or Topside Operators to monitor the quality of produced condensate/oil (e.g., BS&W, salinity, density, RVP).
  • Specification Compliance: Ensure all cargo in storage meets the contractual specifications required for offtake and sale. This involves overseeing the sampling and testing process.
  • Tank Cleaning: Plan and oversee tank cleaning operations to maintain cargo quality and prevent contamination.
  • Cargo Records: Maintain accurate records of all cargo quantities (including ullage/innage gauging) and quality data for reconciliation and customs purposes.

C. Offloading Preparation & Support:

  • Pre-Offloading Readiness: Prepare the cargo system for offloading: line up valves, prepare pumps, and ensure all equipment is functional. Prepare all administration documents include but are not limited to Pre Arrival Check, Cargo Meeting, Sequence Time during Cargo Operation.
  • Support to Mooring Master: Work under the direction of the Mooring Master (a distinct, often more senior role) during the offloading process. The Loading Master's team manages the internal cargo transfer and pumping to the offtake tanker.
  • Cargo Calculation: Accurately calculate and document the quantity of cargo transferred to the shuttle tanker (Bill of Lading figures, Manifest, Statement of Fact), acting as the FPSO's official representative for quantity.

D. Team Management & Safety:

  • Supervision: Directly supervise the Cargo Control Room Operators, Ballast Operator and deck crew involved in cargo and ballast operations.
  • Training: Ensure all team members are trained and competent in operating cargo/ballast systems and emergency procedures.
  • Safety & Compliance: Enforce all safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems, and isolations for work on cargo and ballast systems. Lead by example in implementing the company's Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Emergency Response: Fulfill a key role in the vessel's Emergency Response team, particularly for scenarios related to cargo spills, stability issues, or fire/explosion.

E. Coordination & Administration (Indonesia Focus):

  • Interface with Topside Operations: Maintain constant communication with the Production team lead to align marine storage plans with production rates and shutdowns. This is a critical daily interface.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations comply with Indonesian regulations from:
    • DIRJEN HUBLA (Directorate General of Sea Transportation): Cargo Operations, Vessel stability, safety, and pollution prevention regulations.
    • SKK Migas: Specific reporting and operational requirements for oil and gas upstream activities.
    • Customs & Excise: Accurate reporting of cargo quantities for export and tax purposes.
  • Documentation: Manage all marine-related documentation, including cargo logs, ballast water record books, stability booklets, Intact Stability Booklet and Indonesian regulatory reports.

 

Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ):

·        Comply with rules and standards described in Company Policies, HSE Integrated Management System and Procedures

·        Report all incidents

·        Motivate staff and colleagues to comply with HSE rules and standards

Participate in HSE related initiatives
raw_requirements:
Qualifications & Experience:

·        Education: Minimum Level Class -2 Deck Officer with dangerous cargo endorsement.

·        Professional Qualification:

-      A minimum of 5 years of experience as a Chief Officer (C/O) on crude oil tankers, product tankers, or LNG carriers. Direct experience on an FPSO or FSO is highly desirable and often essential.

-      Proven, hands-on experience in cargo and ballast operations, including extensive use of automated control systems.

-      Demonstrated experience in performing stability and stress calculations for large vessels.

-      Experience in a supervisory role, managing a team of operators.

-      Experience working in Southeast Asia or Indonesia is a significant advantage.

Certification, training and courses:

Mandatory Certifications (STCW & Indonesian):

•     Chief Mate (Class II) or Master Mariner (Class I) Certificate of Competency recognized by the Indonesian government. A Chief Mate ticket is often the minimum requirement.

•     Valid STCW Certificates (Advanced Firefighting, Proficiency in Survival Craft, etc.).

•     Tanker Endorsements: Mandatory STCW certificates for Oil Tanker and preferably Liquefied Gas Tanker operations (for condensate).

•     Seafarer's Medical Certificate.

•     Indonesian Specific Certifications: The company will facilitate, but eligibility is key. This may include:

•    ADPT (Ahli Deklarasi Pengangkutan Tujuan) for hazardous cargo.

•    Familiarization with Indonesian port state and flag state requirements.

Language: Proficient in English and Bahasa

 

Required Competencies:

Technical Competencies

  • Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of tanker operations, hydrodynamics, and crude oil/condensate characteristics.

Non-Technical Competencies

  • Leadership & Teamwork: Ability to lead a marine team and collaborate effectively with the production (topside) department, which often has a different reporting structure and priorities.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot issues with cargo systems, balance stability during production, and manage capacity constraints.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Bahasa Indonesia is a major advantage for managing local crew and understanding local regulations.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Absolute accuracy is required in cargo calculations, stability calculations, and following complex procedures.

 

Working Conditions:

Offshore/FPSO, possibility for business travel to other Eni premises or field areas.

title: AVP of Commercial (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

AVP of Commercial (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

As

AVP of Commercial

, you will lead and integrate SawitPRO’s

Customer Experience, Commercial, B2B Sales, Customer Management, Growth, Marketing, and Performance

functions into one cohesive strategy.

You will be responsible for building and scaling SawitPRO’s relationship with key stakeholders across the palm oil ecosystem, particularly

Palm Oil Mills, mill suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other B2B partners

.

This role combines

commercial leadership and customer experience

, with a strong focus on driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, revenue growth, and long-term ecosystem development.

You will work closely with the CEO and other senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other functions to translate customer and market insights into business growth and strategic outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Experience & Commercial Strategy

Develop and execute SawitPRO’s overall

Customer Experience and Commercial strategy

, aligned with the company’s business objectives.

Own the end-to-end customer journey, from

customer acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, growth, to retention

.

Identify opportunities to improve customer experience while maximizing commercial value and revenue.

Develop strategic initiatives, new channels, business models, and partnerships to accelerate growth.

Build and continuously improve the roadmap and budget for the Experience and Commercial portfolio.

2. B2B Sales & Customer Management

Own the commercial relationship with SawitPRO’s key B2B customer segments, including

Palm Oil Mills, suppliers/agents, FFB Ramps, and other supply-chain stakeholders

.

Develop strategies to acquire, activate, grow, and retain B2B customers and partners.

Understand customer motivations, pain points, business opportunities, competitive landscape, and growth potential.

Build long-term strategic relationships with key customers and ecosystem partners.

Optimize revenue opportunities across the existing customer base.

Establish a strong customer service and relationship management approach to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.

3. FFB Commercial Growth

Lead the commercial strategy for

FFB source acquisition, conversion, and customer management

.

Identify and develop new markets, customer segments, partnerships, and distribution channels to expand SawitPRO’s FFB ecosystem.

Build strategic partnerships with mills, suppliers, ramps, and other relevant stakeholders.

Work closely with internal teams to accelerate the acquisition and activation of FFB sources and maximize their commercial potential.

4. Customer Growth & Engagement

Drive customer growth through

customer intelligence, growth marketing, engagement programs, partnerships, campaigns, and ecosystem development

.

title: Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Smallholder Relationship (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (Full WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

About The Job:

As a Head of Smallholder Management in SawitPRO, you will play a pivotal role in managing a team with focus building and maintaining positive relationships with palm oil smallholders, enabling us to deliver meaningful support and resources to enhance their agricultural practices and economic opportunities. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of smallholder farming communities, excellent communication skills, and a strong commitment to social impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead, coach, and mentor a team of smallholder management professionals, providing guidance, support, and feedback to help them achieve their goals.

Set clear performance targets for the smallholder management team, monitor performance against targets, and take corrective action as needed.

Develop and manage the budget, forecasting revenue and expenses to ensure financial targets are met.

Build and maintain strong relationships with smallholders, especially with our users, by providing support, guidance, and assistance to address their needs and challenges.

Provide smallholder support programs, monitor and evaluate effectiveness, collect feedback and make recommendations, on topics such as sustainable agricultural practices, financial literacy, and market access.

Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and market developments to identify new business opportunities to enhance smallholder livelihoods.

Convert leads into paying users, prepare and present solution proposals, quotes, and contracts, negotiating terms and closing deals.

Collaborate with internal teams, including demand (leads) generation / marketing, customer support, and product development, to ensure customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth.

Keep accurate records of smallholder support programs, interactions with smallholders, pipeline opportunities, and outcomes using CRM software.

Kualifikasi

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Rural Development, Business Administration, Marketing, or any related field.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, especially with smallholders in rural areas. Proficiency in local languages spoken in rural areas is highly desirable.

Excellent negotiation and closing skills, with a focus on achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a drive to succeed in a fast-paced, competitive environment.

Previous experience of at least 3 years working with smallholder or rural communities to provide solutions for them. Palm oil smallholders are preferred.Previous experience of at least 3 years leading a high-performance team.

Deep understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing smallholder farmers, particularly in the areas of agriculture, livelihoods, and rural development.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

Plantation Delivery Executive/Coordinator

Tanggung Jawab Utama (Job Description)

Manajemen & Eksekusi Proyek:

Memimpin end-to-end implementasi solusi/produk SawitPRO di area perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra.

Menyusun rencana proyek, alokasi sumber daya, timeline, serta mengelola risiko teknis maupun operasional di lapangan.

Manajemen Hubungan Pelanggan (Client Management):

Menjadi titik kontak utama (

single point of contact

) bagi manajemen perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra di area Riau/Pekanbaru.

Memahami kebutuhan operasional klien serta memastikan adopsi sistem/produk berjalan secara lancar.

Adopsi & Pelatihan Lapangan:

Mengoordinasikan dan memfasilitasi sesi pelatihan untuk pengelola perkebunan, staf operasional, dan pekerja lapangan agar dapat mengoperasikan sistem dengan efektif.

Memantau tingkat penggunaan (

usage rate

) produk dan memberikan panduan atau solusi berkelanjutan bagi klien.

Koordinasi Lintas Fungsi:

Bekerja sama erat dengan tim Product, Engineering, Sales, dan Operations internal untuk menyampaikan

feedback

dari lapangan dan penyelesaian masalah teknis secara cepat.

Melakukan pelaporan berkala terkait status proyek dan kesehatan akun (

account health

) kepada pimpinan.

Minimal S1 di bidang Perkebunan/Pertanian, Sistem Informasi, Teknik, atau jurusan terkait.

Sertifikasi manajemen proyek (seperti PMP) menjadi nilai tambah.

Pengalaman Kerja:

project implementation

), operasional perkebunan kelapa sawit, atau penyebaran perangkat lunak enterprise (

enterprise software deployment

).

Memiliki pengalaman langsung bekerja/berinteraksi dengan perkebunan kelapa sawit.

Terbiasa mengoordinasikan tim lintas fungsi (

cross-functional teams

) dan mengelola beberapa proyek bersamaan.

Kebun Pro

dan layanan operasional terkait) pada perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra di wilayah Pekanbaru dan sekitarnya. Anda akan menjadi penghubung utama antara tim internal SawitPRO dengan klien perkebunan untuk memastikan proyek berjalan sesuai jadwal, cakupan, dan standar kualitas terbaik.

Manajemen & Eksekusi Proyek:

Memimpin end-to-end implementasi solusi/produk SawitPRO di area perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra.

Menjadi titik kontak utama (

single point of contact

) bagi manajemen perkebunan kelapa sawit mitra di area Riau/Pekanbaru.

Memahami kebutuhan operasional klien serta memastikan adopsi sistem/produk berjalan secara lancar.

Adopsi & Pelatihan Lapangan:

Mengoordinasikan dan memfasilitasi sesi pelatihan untuk pengelola perkebunan, staf operasional, dan pekerja lapangan agar dapat mengoperasikan sistem dengan efektif.

Memantau tingkat penggunaan (

usage rate

) produk dan memberikan panduan atau solusi berkelanjutan bagi klien.

Koordinasi Lintas Fungsi:

Bekerja sama erat dengan tim Product, Engineering, Sales, dan Operations internal untuk menyampaikan

feedback

dari lapangan dan penyelesaian masalah teknis secara cepat.

Melakukan pelaporan berkala terkait status proyek dan kesehatan akun (

account health

) kepada pimpinan.

project implementation

enterprise software deployment

).

Memiliki pengalaman langsung bekerja/berinteraksi dengan perkebunan kelapa sawit.

Terbiasa mengoordinasikan tim lintas fungsi (

cross-functional teams

) dan mengelola beberapa proyek bersamaan.

title: HBB Fault Management & Service Assurance
raw_description:
Job Description

- Ensure HBB end-to-end network elements incident (infrastructure) & Quality Performance, network configuration & integration management and services, monitoring, tracking and problem management are handled excellently according to network KPI, agreed SLA, and standard methodology, for 24 hours/day, 7 days/week and to avoid any service degradation and company revenue loss.

-           Ensure service problem tracking and monitoring of any network disruption as impact of project activities.

-           Responsible to define, develop & review to continuously improving in the fault management, operation of HBB network to manage network service within a defined SLA.

-           Manage related MS vendors team in day-to-day Fault Management Operation;

-           Consolidate to other functions for issues which are related to HBB network operation and service quality

 

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities
  1. Network Fault Monitoring & Management
  • Build the guidance in monitoring fault management with HBB Network Manage Service in order to solve the repeated problem issue, massive problem issue and to take preventive action/plan for identified (potential) problem.
  • Set up the strategy approach and prioritized program with HBB Network Manage Service to improve the performance service align with defined KPI/KQI.
  • Build the guidance with HBB Network Manage Service team in order to identify, localize and point out the right domain of root cause for every degraded service happened.  
  •  
  •  
  1. Network & Services Problem Tracking
  • With HBB Network Manage Service, build and control the Network & services problem tracking system effectively.
  • Manage the Network & services problem tracking as single point of contact for problem status information.
  • Lead in evaluating and improving the performance of service problem tracking system.
  1. External Relation
  • Serve as a company representative for external related functions

 

In order to build good network in the industry and keep up to date with new trends
  1. On time and accurate reporting

Managing HBB Network Manage Service:

  • Ensure on time Daily, Weekly and Monthly HBB Network Report.
  • Ensure on time Weekly SLA Achievement, Weekly HBB KPI achievement

 

Requirement

 

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

 

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering.
  • Proven track record in designing and deploying FTTH and FWA networks.
  • Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

 

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills for fault management.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills for documentation and reporting.

Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and business needs

Job Responsibilities

Operational Excellence
Operational Issue Resolution
Operational Management and Performance Monitoring
Operational Performance Monitoring
Operational Support and Coordination

title: VP-Head of HBB & B2B Planning
raw_description:
Long Description

Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of FTTH and FWA technologies and network architecture principles.
  • Strong understanding of B2B business and solution
  • Professional certification in Network Engineering
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry standards for telecommunications.

 

Experience:

  • Has extensive experience at least 5 years of experience in telecommunications network planning and engineering, multiple business unit background of working experiences in HBB & B2B would be an advantage
  • Experience in capacity planning and performance optimization transport for broadband networks.
  • Hands-on experience with cost estimation and budgeting for large-scale network projects.
  • Familiarity with emerging home broadband technologies and industry trends.

 

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to design efficient network solutions.
  • Has excellent reporting, presentation and persuasion skill capabilities.
  • Has excellent knowledge of telecommunication business & process in general.
  • Has broad knowledge of technology roadmap especially in HBB and B2B requirements.
  • Has excellent knowledge in translating business requirement into technical or functional specification.
  • Has strategic thinking of end-to-end demand lifecycle process (requirement, solution and delivery), budget, governance and resources.
  • Has strong business and financial acumen with a sense of shareholder responsibility

 

 

Long Description

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Strategic Planning
  1. Establish divisional KPI based on organizational scorecard and cascaded down the teams for HBB & B2B Planning task
  2. Manage division budget based on work-plan and control the utilization/realization of it

 

  • In order to ensure division operates on budget and help contribute to organizational goals

HBB & B2B Network Planning and Solutions
  1. Capture HBB & B2B business requirements and align with stake holder internally IOH and CKH/OG counterparts, ensuring that the local requirements of IOH are taken into account and the right solutions aligned with B2B business objective in 1 -5 years roadmap.
  2. Align with HBB & B2B and all stake holder including subsidiaries to have synergy and  best solutions and ensure the solution is feasible, implemented and operational running smoothly and competitive in the market. Target FMC (fixed Mobile Convergence) to lock the customer always stay with IOH is the ultimate target
  3. Setup right design principle on HBB, SLA and KPI to drive the partner to deliver for best network in class with the contiguous improvement plan

 

Team Management
  1. Develop and mentor team member(s) to achieve divisional objectives
  2. Monitor and evaluate the performance of staff, make recommendations to supervisor and implement actions, such as promotions and dismissals
  3. Provide feedback to SVP to work with HR team to create the succession plan for the function/ organization and attract, motivate and retain top talent to ensure alignment with the plan

 

In order to ensure talents are attracted, retained developed to meet organizational needs

External Relation
  1. Serve as a company representative for external related functions
  2. To manage the partnership with HBB & B2B 3rd party to have the right operartion model and design principle

 

In order to build good network in the industry and keep the performance and CX in the best quality

title: VP-Head of Financial Non Bank
raw_description:
Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
  • Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
  • Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
  • Monitor and report project progress against targets.
  • Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
  • Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
  • Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
  • Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
  • At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
  • Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
  • Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
  • Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
  • Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage

title: Searah Muara Bakau - Metering Technician (KNH)
raw_description:
Purpose:

The Metering Technician is responsible to ensure that operating parameters for all metering equipment at Eni’s onshore facilities are operating within design limits and that any abnormalities are communicated and assessed immediately. Supervise and coordination routine validation test of Metering System with government (Ditjen MIGAS, SKK MIGAS, and any other relevant functions) to get approval of overall system.

Metering Technician guarantee the prompt, safe and environment respecting execution of all Maintenance activities that will be conducted in safe manner with maximizing uptime and field production efficiency while minimizing the total maintenance cost (production downtime, spare parts, man power, etc). Meet daily production targets whilst complying with company guidelines and legal requirements to deliver highest value to stakeholders without compromise to safe operating principals.


General Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

  • Provide metering support to operations and maintenance teams to ensure all relevant metering equipment is operational, in service, maintained safely, effectively and in accordance with procedures and equipment design codes and standards.
  • Complete the plan and breakdown maintenance to flow metering & associated instrumentation at onshore locations in Eni’s facilities.
  • Campaign maintenance on oil/gas Fiscal Metering and Allocation Metering systems.
  • Support annual metering system re-certification activities per SKK Migas’s PTK062
  • Support safe start up and shutdown of process facilities. Assist operator to ensure safe start up and shutdown of process facilities.
  • Liaise with direct superior and operations personnel to ensure all work is co-coordinated and aligned with production priorities and within the job plan & schedules issued include reporting by the Planner from the CMMS. Maintain complete and accurate equipment history records within the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Liaise with CCRO Operator, Operation Supervisor, Operator Technician and Field Operator to early capture any operation anomalies and abnormality.
  • Perform control system daily check and database backup base on planned schedule. Liaise with Planner & Scheduler with regard to the forward planning of spare parts deliverability and in determining minimum/maximum stock levels of spare parts and maintenance consumables on the facility.
  • Conduct and coordinate contractor related to metering system & relevant contractors to inspections Control equipment operation and condition to determine remedial action.
  • Carry out risk assessments for all high-risk activities, with particular attention to recognizing the impact of change.

title: Prima Energy - HSE Inspector (CPP/FPSO/FSO)
raw_description:
Role Overview

Conduct HSE inspections and monitor offshore activities to identify hazards, ensure compliance with HSE procedures and applicable regulations, and support safe, reliable, and environmentally responsible operations.

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct routine and targeted HSE inspections, identify unsafe acts and conditions, and follow up corrective actions.
  • Monitor compliance with PTW, JSA/JHA, risk assessments, LOTO, SIMOPS, and other HSE requirements.
  • Monitor high-risk activities, including lifting, confined space entry, hot work, working at height, pressure testing, and marine operations.
  • Inspect emergency response equipment, participate in emergency drills, and support incident investigations.
  • Monitor environmental protection, waste management, hazardous materials, and spill prevention measures.
  • Report incidents, near misses, and HSE deviations, and maintain accurate inspection records and reports.
  • Conduct toolbox talks, safety briefings, and HSE awareness activities.
  • Monitor contractor HSE performance and verify personnel competency and certification for critical activities.
  • HSE Management System, HIRADC/HAZID, JSA/JHA, PTW, SIMOPS, and LOTO.
  • Emergency response, fire and gas systems, process safety, hydrocarbon release prevention, and incident investigation.
  • Marine safety, personnel transfer, helideck safety, lifting operations, dropped object prevention, evacuation, and working over water.
  • Environmental management, contractor HSE management, and safety reporting.
raw_requirements:
Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or any major related discipline.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of HSE experience in oil & gas, marine, petrochemical, or heavy industry, preferably including 3–5 years of offshore experience.
  • Experience in offshore production facilities, such as WHP, CPP, FPSO/FSO, drilling rigs, or offshore construction facilities.

Certifications

  • AK3 Umum / relevant K3 competency certification.
  • BOSIET/FOET, H2S Awareness, and basic firefighting for offshore deployment, as applicable.
  • Competency in PTW, risk assessment/JSA, incident investigation, and emergency response.
  • First aid, working at height, confined space, lifting and rigging, and LOTO certifications are preferred.

Oversee the forecasting process, including coordinating input from multiple divisions and departments, and building financial models and templates. raw_description:
Food Demand Strategy, Assistant Manager

Team

Business Strategy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The ID Food Demand Planning Team is the think tank and in-house strategy overseeing overall topline in Grab ID's P&L and improving user growth across all verticals businesses including mobility and delivery verticals. Our main focus is on developing executable business strategies that align with our mission of serving the community.

Get to Know the Role

We are seeking an analytical Food Demand Strategy Assistant Manager to join our team in Jakarta, Indonesia.

You will bridge demand strategy development and operational demand execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders to get the alignment on demand levers and strategies in order to help achieve P&L topline, track financial and lever's performance, and contribute to business planning cycles. You will report to the Food Demand Strategy Manager and will be based onsite in the Grab Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Partner up with food vertical, S&P territory, FP&A, promo operations teams to carry out the following:

Structure the problem statements including root cause analysis to ensure we are solving the right problems

Develop the campaign designs which includes offering scheme, funding scheme as well as profitability level

Monitor campaign performance including financial and operational performance metrics and flag variances that require attention or immediate actions

Design, build, and maintain performance dashboards that visualize key financial metrics, ensuring data accuracy and refreshes for stakeholder access

Identify all trade-offs in terms of business impact between each option during decision making process

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

A minimum of 4 years of experience in strategy, business analysis, and/or campaign development roles. Experience in the technology industry is a plus.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration/Business Management, Industrial Engineering

Proven experience in financial modeling, simulation and analysis

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Join the Cyber Assurance – Vendor Security team to help make third-party risk reviews more consistent and scalable through hands-on vendor assessments and practical automation across intake, evidence tracking, and reporting. Partnering with key stakeholders across Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Cybersecurity, you will apply a solid foundation in information security and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) frameworks to elevate our vendor security posture.

Get to Know the Role

Join a team that prioritizes engineering over administrative overhead. With a clear architectural vision and established stakeholder relationships, this role is dedicated to building the engine: combining practical software engineering with security risk practices to build tools and workflows that standardize vendor assessments. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta. You will be reporting to the Principal Cyber Security Specialist, Cyber & Tech Regulatory Partnership.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Work with internal stakeholders to understand assessment needs and translate them into clear data, workflow, and reporting requirements.

Gather vendor engagement details, including services, data involved, access, hosting, sub-processors, and system integrations.

Review vendor questionnaires, security evidence, and relevant contract terms against Grab's security requirements and identify gaps and prepare evidence based findings.

Build, test, and maintain scoped automations that reduce repeat manual work, such as data validation, evidence tracking, and assessment reporting.

Support the mapping and integration of relevant risk data from internal sources, documenting data quality, access, and workflow assumptions.

Support reviews of AI vendors, including data privacy, model security under the guidance of experienced reviewers.

Coordinate evidence requests and follow-up actions with vendors and internal stakeholders; maintain review records and surface recurring issues or improvement opportunities.

1+ years of relevant experience

or hands-on exposure in software development, automation, information security, or IT risk (internships, academic coursework, and practical projects are welcomed).

Degree or equivalent practical learning

title: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

The role also supports the Tuna Project as and when required, while ensuring Subsea Development activities are Delivered Safely, Efficiently and in line with approved Scope, Schedule, Budget, Quality and Regulatory Commitments.

This position oversees all Subsea works at Tuna Block and Natuna Block.

Qualification / Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
  • Minimum 15 years of Experience in the Upstream Oil and Gas Industry, with Strong Exposure to Electrohydraulic Subsea Well Development, preferably covering FEED and EPCI phases in a Leading or Managerial role.
  • Strong Leadership and Stakeholder Management Skills, with the ability to Lead Multidisciplinary teams and Coordinate Interfaces across various Functions.
  • Proven experience across the Subsea Project Lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing/Fabrication, Construction, Installation, Pre-commissioning, Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Experience in Contractor Engineering Management and Technical Assurance, including Review and Approval of Engineering Deliverables, rRsolution of Technical Queries and Monitoring of Contractor Performance.
  • Demonstrated Capability in Managing Critical Interfaces among Subsea Production Systems, Wells, Umbilicals, Risers, Flowlines, Fixed Infrastructure and Floating Facilities.

 

Special Skills / Knowledge:

  • Familiar with Project Planning and Control, Contract and Risk Management.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with Proficiency in MS Office and relevant Project Management Tools/Software.
  • In-depth Knowledge and Experience in Subsea Well Development from Conceptual Study until Commissioning and Start-up.
  • Broad and Extensive Knowledge of Components, Hardware, Infrastructures and Facilities required for Subsea Well Development.
  • Comprehensive understanding on the Modifications required at the Existing Facilities to support Subsea Development.
  • Able to implement and embed applicable Subsea Engineering Codes, Standards and specifications to effect Project Delivery.
  • Good Knowledge of Regulatory Framework and relevant Legislation.
  • Having latest Knowledge of Industry and Technology Development associated with Subsea Well Development.

title: Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Jambi)

Daftar Sekarang

Jambi, Jambi City, Jambi, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Jambi.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Daftar Sekarang

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Production Operator
location: Jl. Raya Bogor, KM 26.6, Kel. Pekayon, Kec. Pasar Rebo, Jakarta Timur  - Jakarta Timur
raw_description:
• Perform tipping operations for sugar and milk powder into silos according to production requirements and mixing schedules.

  • Coordinate raw material requests with Warehouse forklift operators to ensure timely material availability for production.

  • Operate conveyor dumpers and hydraulic lifting table dumpers in accordance with operating procedures and safety standards.

  • Ensure accurate and proper transfer of raw materials into designated silos, following material handling procedures and production instructions.

  • Record and monitor raw material mass balance to maintain accurate records of materials received, consumed, and remaining.

  • Complete production administration and operational reports for tipping dumper activities accurately and on time.

  • Perform cleaning and sanitation of equipment and work areas in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and food manufacturing hygiene standards.

  • Maintain workplace cleanliness and organization through effective housekeeping and 5S practices.

  • Comply with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) requirements, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) standards, and applicable safety procedures when operating equipment and handling raw materials.
raw_requirements:
• Minimum Diploma (D3), preferably in:

    • Food Technology

    • Biology

    • Chemistry

    • Agricultural Industrial Technology

    • Other relevant STEM fields.

  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

  • Proficient in basic arithmetic, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, to support material calculations and mass balance recording.

  • Detail-oriented in material recording, measurement, and production reporting.

  • Basic knowledge of, or willingness to learn, manufacturing processes, sanitation, GMP, and OHS in the food industry.

  • Physically fit to perform the operational duties required for the position.

  • Must not have a dust allergy that could interfere with job performance, subject to workplace exposure assessment and available risk controls.

  • Willing to work in areas involving elevated access or work at height when required, in accordance with applicable safety procedures.

  • Willing to work on a shift basis.

  • Demonstrates integrity, discipline, a strong work ethic, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

  • Willing to comply with personal hygiene, cleanliness, and food safety requirements in the production environment.

  • Available to join immediately.

Employment Type: PKWT (Fixed-Term Employment Agreement)

Contract Duration: 6 months

title: Prime Natuna EP - Floating Infrastructure Sr. Electrical Engineer
raw_description:
Responsible for designing Electrical System for FPSO Project Development and ensure its safe and optimum project delivery as well as reliable operation. 

Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

  • ​​​Implement project requirements into Electrical design. 
  • ​Provide electrical load list, schematic diagrams, single line diagrams, cable schedules and MTO using Smart Plant Electrical. 
  • ​Perform power system studies (short circuit, coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics) using ETAP. 
  • ​Perform Insulation coordination and transient study using PSCAD or EMTP software. 
  • ​Perform calculations for equipment sizing, UPS, cable sizing, lighting, grounding and heat tracing. 
  • ​Prepare specifications, data sheets, cable schedules and interface schedules. 
  • ​Produce material take-off and material requisition. 
  • ​Review Bids and Technical Evaluation. 
  • ​Design and checking of single lines, schematics and wiring diagrams, area classification, grounding, panel/cable schedules, equipment layout, cable layout, tray layout, lighting and installation details without supervision. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 3D model with the other disciplines. 
  • ​Review and coordinate electrical 2D AutoCAD/ Micro-station drawings. 
  • ​Visit construction/plant sites and fabrication shops during design phase on as required basis. 
  • ​Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for electrical systems are delivered safely as per company requirement. 
  • ​Develop electrical engineering report for Project Development Management in a timely manner 
  • ​Performs non-routine tasks and attends such meetings as directed from time to time by Project Development Sr. Manager as opportunity presents in order to meet Company objectives.  Ensures that all relevant managers and subordinates are kept informed of all major opportunities, developments, problems or potential problems, which will impact upon the Business.
  • Indonesian Nationality
raw_requirements:
Qualification / Work Experience:

  • ​​​​​​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. 
  • ​Min. 15 years working experience as an electrical engineer for offshore floating infrastructure within oil and gas industry, preferably experience in project stage. 
  • ​Experienced in electrical design using Smart Plant Electrical or other electrical design software. 
  • ​ Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering within the oil & gas industry, with strong exposure to offshore floating infrastructure projects, particularly FPSO, preferably covering project development, FEED, detailed engineering, and execution phases.
  • Proven experience in electrical system design and engineering for offshore floating facilities, including preparation and review of electrical engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Experience in electrical engineering software and power system studies, including SmartPlant Electrical, ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent engineering applications.
  • Experience in construction, fabrication, pre-commissioning, and start-up support for electrical systems in offshore facilities is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with proficiency in MS Office and relevant electrical engineering tools/software.

Special Skills / Knowledge:

       • In-depth expertise in detailed engineering and design of electrical power systems for offshore floating facilities, particularly FPSO, covering power generation and distribution, electrical      equipment, cabling, grounding, lighting, UPS, and heat tracing systems.

      • Strong capability in electrical power system studies and analysis, including load flow/load assessment, short circuit, protection coordination, motor starting, arc flash, harmonics, insulation coordination, and transient studies using ETAP, PSCAD/EMTP, or equivalent tools.

      • Strong capability in developing and reviewing key electrical engineering deliverables, including load lists, single-line diagrams, schematics, equipment sizing calculations, cable schedules, equipment layouts, specifications, datasheets, material requisitions, and MTOs.

      • Comprehensive knowledge of international electrical codes, standards, and hazardous-area requirements applicable to offshore facilities, including ANSI, IEEE, IEC, NEC, NEMA, CSA, UL, API, and relevant area-classification requirements.

      • Strong multidisciplinary interface and constructability capability for FPSO electrical systems, including coordination with other engineering disciplines, 3D model reviews, vendor technical evaluations, and support during fabrication, construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up

title: Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)
raw_description:
< Kembali

Head of Sales (Pekanbaru/Medan)

Daftar Sekarang

Sumatra, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Primary Responsibilities

To oversee and integrate SawitPRO's Commercial, Marketing, Demand Planning, Customer Management, B2B sales, Growth, and Performance Measurement functions into a cohesive strategy. Oversee function:

Customer Experience to manage the following for the customers (primarily B2B)

Customer research, Customer acquisition, Customer engagement, Customer relationship management and Customer retention

Customer growth, including Growth Marketing through the development of a partner ecosystem, Customer Intelligence and Customers’ competitor Intelligence

Customer engagement events and marketing campaigns

Role of the Head of Sales:

Strategy & Ideation – The person responsible must develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's brand, as well as its customer and employee experiences.

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the experience portfolio (XP)

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas to further the goals of the experience portfolio across all aspects of the organisation

Roadmap development – Develop the roadmap and budget for managing the experience portfolio by optimising the return on investment

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organisation

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management, including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc., to deliver on the strategic business outcomes, including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organisation. Utilise business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

Experience gamification for optimised engagement of stakeholders across all aspects of the XP

Kualifikasi

Education

A bachelor’s Degree in Business or Marketing, or any related discipline, is required.

Experience

Min.  10 years’ experience working ideally in business management, Strong Marketing & sales/business Development, customer service, industrial design, etc., in driving digital initiatives with some independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise-wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organisation and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in consumer industries like fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc., is preferred

Knowledge/Skills

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Ability to develop short interaction levers to drive strategic behaviours through gamification, rewards and engagement

Extensive knowledge of digital marketing, analytics, growth hacking and CRM.

Business-savvy strategic thinking: Big picture orientation and conceptualisation of ideas, conceiving effective strategies to drive growth and revenue generation

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital technologies to business leaders and business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future for Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

SawitPRO is a game-changer, improving the smallholders’ living standard and helping our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil through efficient land use.

Lead and drive SawitPRO's FFB (Fresh Fruit Bunch) crop commercial strategy, focusing on growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships to support the acquisitions of FFB sources and funnel these sources into our partner mills.

title: Head of Customer Acquisition and Fulfilment
raw_description:
The Head of Customer Acquisition & Fulfillment owns the end-to-end journey of a sold order into an active FTTH service — from customer verification and validation through to installation, activation, and service delivery. This is an AVP-level role leading two functions, Verification & Validation and Service Delivery, and is accountable for ensuring genuine customer acquisition, preventing fraud/recycle-customer cases, and delivering the installation and activation experience promised at the point of sale. Beyond the order itself, the role orchestrates the full onboarding ecosystem — Sales, digital ordering channels, verification, field technicians, and fiber partners — so that acquisition volume grows without compromising quality, and it remains accountable for service quality in the customer's early life after activation. The role plays a critical part in protecting revenue integrity and driving FTTH's targets for interaction volume, First Call Resolution (FCR), and Customer Care CSAT, by ensuring orders are fulfilled right the first time and customers become genuine, satisfied, and retained subscribers.

Scope of Work

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Deliverables

1. Customer Acquisition (Verification & Validation)

-  Lead the Verification & Validation team to confirm FTTH service availability at the customer's location against coverage maps/databases and required infrastructure.

-  Ensure every prospective customer is validated as a genuine customer prior to onboarding, preventing recycle-customer / fraud cases.

-  Set, monitor, and continuously improve verification SLA and accuracy targets; escalate coverage or infrastructure gaps to Technology/Network partners.

Verification & Validation SOP and coverage / infrastructure check workflow

Verification SLA and accuracy performance dashboard

 

Fraud / recycle-customer detection and escalation log.

2. Order Fulfillment & Service Delivery

-  Lead the Service Delivery function across order management, installation scheduling, site preparation, installation/activation, and quality assurance (interim coverage while the dedicated Head of Service Delivery role is vacant).

-  Ensure customer orders progress smoothly from sale through activation, coordinating with Sales, Billing, Technical, and Field Partner teams.

-  Own installation SLA performance, activation turnaround time, and first-time-right installation quality.

Order-to-activation SOP covering scheduling, site prep, installation, and activation;

 

installation SLA and activation turnaround time report;

 

first-time-right installation quality scorecard.

3. End-to-End Order-to-Activation Ownership

-  Act as the single point of accountability for the full journey from sold order to a genuine, verified, and successfully installed/activated service.

-  Build and maintain an integrated reporting cadence covering verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, and CSAT.

-  Resolve cross-functional bottlenecks between the acquisition (verification) and fulfillment (installation/activation) stages.

integrated acquisition-to-fulfillment performance dashboard (verification accuracy, installation SLA, activation success rate, CSAT)

 

cross-functional bottleneck/issue log with resolution status

 

monthly end-to-end funnel report (sold order → verified → installed → activated).

4. Recycle-Customer Prevention & Verification Integrity

-  Design and own a risk-based verification framework (identity/NIK, address, payment and bad-debt history, prior disconnection and blacklist screening) with clear auto-pass, auto-review, and manual-verification tiers, so recycle and fraudulent customers are blocked before order confirmation while genuine customers stay on a fast, low-friction path.

-  Govern both sides of the trade-off — false-positive rate (genuine customers rejected or delayed) and false-negative rate (recycle customers admitted) — and recalibrate rules, thresholds, and blacklist criteria together with Sales, Finance/Collection, and Fraud Management.

-  Own the authority to reject, hold, or release high-risk orders, and ensure every verification touchpoint follows approved script, channel, and maximum-contact standards so that tightened controls do not increase customer effort, order drop-off, or CSAT loss.

Risk-based verification & anti-recycle policy, including tiering rules, blacklist criteria, and decision authority matrix

 

Recycle/fraud prevention scorecard: recycle-customer rate, detection rate, false-positive rate, and verification turnaround time

 

Verification customer-experience standard with drop-off/CSAT tracking, and monthly rule-calibration review minutes.

5. Sales & Digital Order Journey Collaboration (Cancel-Registration Reduction)

-  Partner with HBB & FWA Sales, HBB Product, and the digital application/web owners to simplify the customer ordering journey — coverage check, registration, document upload, payment, and installation scheduling — reducing steps, rework, and abandonment.

-  Own the analysis of cancelled and abandoned registrations by journey stage, channel, sales agent, and region, and convert the findings into a prioritised change backlog with the application owners.

-  Agree and track joint KPIs with Sales and application owners (order completion rate, cancel-registration rate, order-to-verified cycle time), including agent- and channel-level feedback on mis-sold, incomplete, or out-of-coverage orders.

Order journey funnel analysis (order → registration → payment → verified) with drop-off and cancellation root-cause breakdown

 

Prioritised digital ordering-journey improvement backlog agreed with product/application owners, with before-after impact tracking

 

Joint Sales–Fulfillment KPI dashboard and monthly Sales–Product–Fulfillment review forum minutes with action tracker.

6. End-to-End Onboarding Journey Orchestration

-  Own the design and governance of the end-to-end onboarding journey so that Sales, Verification & Validation, field technicians, fiber partners (AMT, Iforte), Network/Technology, Billing, and the contact center operate as one cohesive chain with clear handover points, SLAs, and RACI.

-  Chair a cross-functional onboarding governance forum to resolve interlock issues (coverage versus sale, port and material availability, technician scheduling, partner capacity) and enforce the quality gates that protect growth: verified feasibility before installation, and completed checklist plus customer confirmation before activation.

-  Model verification, technician, and fiber-partner capacity against the sales forecast, flag capacity risk to Sales and Leadership early, and drive one shared onboarding scorecard so every stakeholder is measured on the same end-to-end outcome.

End-to-end onboarding journey map with RACI, handover SLAs, and quality gates across all internal and partner stakeholders

 

Cross-functional onboarding governance forum: cadence, minutes, escalation matrix, and issue-resolution log

 

Acquisition quality index (gross orders → verified → activated → early cancellation/churn) with capacity-versus-forecast risk flags.

7. Post-Onboarding Service Quality (Early-Life Customer Experience)

-  Own service quality for the first 30/60/90 days after activation — early-life fault rate, repeat trouble tickets, early complaints, and early churn.

-  Run a structured post-installation follow-up and onboarding CSAT/NPS programme, and feed the results back to technicians, fiber partners, and sales channels as accountable quality signals.

-  Analyse early-life complaints by root cause (installation workmanship, ONT/device, network, billing, or expectation gap created at the point of sale), drive upstream corrective action with the accountable owner, and escalate systemic issues to the VP-Head of HBB Operations.

Post-onboarding service quality dashboard (D+7 / D+30 / D+90 fault rate, repeat ticket rate, early churn)

 

Onboarding CSAT/NPS report with driver analysis by technician, fiber partner, and sales channel

 

Early-life root-cause and corrective action log, with a quarterly improvement report to Leadership showing before-after results.

8. People Management

-  Lead and develop the Verification & Validation and Service Delivery teams, setting clear KPIs and measuring performance regularly.

-  Own team structure and tasks, recruitment, performance management, team building, succession planning, mentoring, and training.

-  Provide feedback through 1:1s, personal development plans, and coaching to build a strong pipeline for the future Service Delivery headcount.

team KPI scorecards and performance review records;

 

Succession plan and development plans (PDPs) for Verification & Validation / Service Delivery staff;

 

Training and coaching completion log.

9. Partner Management

-  Manage the performance and SLAs of field/fiber partners (e.g., AMT, Iforte) and the contact center partner (PT VADS) relevant to acquisition and fulfillment.

-  Conduct partner performance reviews and drive corrective action plans for service or quality shortfalls.

Partner Management: partner (AMT, Iforte, Managed Service Contact Center) SLA performance report

 

partner review minutes and corrective action plans (CAPs).

10. Continuous Improvement

-  Ensure the team is continuously trained and capable of maintaining high-quality customer interactions.

-  Identify new tools and technologies to better verify, onboard, and serve customers.

-  Continually develop process improvements and lead change projects across verification and fulfillment workflows, using customer insights and analytics to identify companywide improvements and present these to Leadership.

Process improvement / change project tracker with before-after results;

 

tools & technology adoption roadmap; leadership improvement recommendation deck (from customer insights/analytics).

 

Minimum Requirements
